w: After concluding his morning puja, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of deities to be installed in BAPS hari mandirs in Memnagar (Amdavad), Odhav (Amdavad), Khoraj and Sector 22, Gandhinagar.

At about 10.00 am Swamishri performed the foundation-stone laying ceremony of ‘Jivan Sandhya Kutir’ (home for senior citizens) and also inaugurated the newly built student’s hostel called ‘Ishavasyam Chhatralay’ of Hiramani Vidyalay in Chharodi on the outskirts of Amdavad. Thereafter Swamishri addressed the assembly of dignitaries and blessed Shri Narharibhai Amin, the president and proprietor of the Hiramani Educational Trust.
Swamishri performed the arti of Thakorji on the mandir’s 10th consecration anniversary celebration (patotsav). In the evening assembly Swamishri discoursed about worshipping God from a young age.
Two BAPS sadhus and 25 youths, and 5 devotees from Dudhvala pilgrimaged by foot.
